steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Your Party Bar
steps.body:
See those hero cards at the bottom of the screen? That's your Party Bar. It shows every hero in your active party at a glance — their stats, health, and equipment.

You can manage everything about your party right from there.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Gear Management
steps.body: Click the Gear button on any hero card to equip weapons, armor, and accessories. You can also equip a backpack in the Bag slot to carry more items into the dungeon.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Before You Go
steps.body:
Hover over any stat in the hero info panel to see a full breakdown — base, racial bonus, and gear. Beyond Attack and Defense, keep an eye on Speed (determines turn order and multi-actions) and Crit (bonus damage chance).

Fill hero bags with consumables before heading out, and visit the Shop to stock up on potions and gear. Good luck out there, Shopkeeper!
